kinds.test-file: a test file (Rust #[test]/#[tokio::test] or TS it/test) meant to drive a harness
kinds.test-fragment: a fenced block (issue or report) meant to be added to an existing test
kinds.rust-unit-test: a Rust #[test] that calls program functions directly, driving no Solana harness
kinds.script: a TS/JS script run with node (no it/test)
kinds.binary-main: a Rust binary with fn main
